disposition.change: Drop the uuid CROSS_REF account_payment_id and keep one varchar(255) business-key column for the ACE payment_code with no foreign key.

disposition.change: Reconcile FEAT-PAY-11 to the ACE payment and account position and the posting file; record a ledger return as an open question until the ledger owner publishes one.
disposition.note: Daily reconciliation is rwb-payment scope, not this treatment story.

disposition.change: Keep one matching run per business date in wave 2; record the same-day payment-received trigger as an open question; add an intraday run only when a daytime payment interface is named.
disposition.note: Run cadence is rwb-payment's; this story consumes the match per business date.

disposition.change: State a receipts-per-business-date figure derived from the observed receipt-to-installment ratio on ACE data for a busy month; use the ratio as an assumption until then.
disposition.note: No receipt volume exists in NFR-001 or NFR-007; volume test belongs to the NFR set.

disposition.change: Split the record: rwb-payment writes and publishes the local record in its own transaction; rwb-decision collects, appends to the hash-chained ledger and runs JOB-14, evaluating no payment.
disposition.note: Record ownership is decided in P8 and the Work Package; this story holds only the treatment side.

disposition.change: Fix one DecisionRecorded shape and consumer group, take decision codes from LOV-DECISION, carry inputs_ref as an opaque reference, keep the input age limit key as a DP-06 placeholder, publish the page default.
disposition.note: Payload and operation names are contract elements of rwb-payment, not this story.

disposition.change: Publish v1 with the two operations, three event schemas, nine declarations, schema baseline and message map; mark unsettled elements with the placeholder and one review row.
disposition.note: Contract slice of rwb-payment; gated by contract tests and schema lint.

disposition.change: Ship one chart with api and worker deployments, migration job, topics, consumer groups, five alerts with runbook links, four dashboard series, flag, backfill and rollback; take thresholds as environment values.
disposition.note: Deployment values belong to rwb-payment; not stated in this treatment story.

disposition.change: Plan advance by applyProceedsMatched on ProceedsMatched and missed installment held by holdMissedInstallment on PaymentMissed, both through this service's inbox; position served on the treatment read.
disposition.note: Activity names added to the decision row and the event row; package and frequency confirmed at contract freeze.

disposition.change: Publish three event schemas with the data fields the legacy story names per event and the platform CloudEvents envelope; require a new schema version for any added business field.
disposition.note: Event data elements are fixed by the P8 contract, not in this story.
